references.text: The prophecy of God's good shepherd who gathers the lambs in his arms and carries them on his chest, paralleling Jesus' description of his loving care for the sheep.
The description of the one who is offered up and led like a lamb to slaughter, directly foreshadowing Jesus' act of laying down his life for the sheep.
God's promise to seek out his lost ones himself and rescue his scattered ones, a direct fulfillment of the shepherd role that Jesus takes on.
The promise to raise up a shepherd, David, who will tend them, a messianic prophecy that Jesus fulfills as the good shepherd.
Jesus' own explanation of what it means to be a good shepherd: to lay down his life for the sheep, directly retelling the theme in 10:15.
The Christian exhortation to lay down one's life for the brothers, as a direct application of Jesus' example as the good shepherd.
